secondary_audits.content: Literal repository mappings and the source dependency chain are preserved without corpus endpoint resolution or edge emission.
Claims of simulators, benchmarks, implementations and module implementation remain source-described program status; R25 frozen head is documentation-only.
Causal stack arrows, E*->C_rev and CTC transition expressions are proposed structures without established intervention/identification protocols on this surface.
C_improve, Omega, C, Theta, n*, G, D_c, C_e, A_c, G_V and residual agency remain proposed constructs with unresolved scale/estimator issues.
Persistent residual plus structural change does not uniquely identify representation failure or mechanism-space expansion.
Validation file contains specifications and falsifiable hypotheses but no frozen execution, empirical result, negative result or reproduction record.
Repeated equations, loops and module mappings retain occurrence provenance but do not generate independent warrant.
